content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `ChecksumFileSystem` class not properly handling the input stream when the `verifyChecksum` flag was set. The original implementation directly returned a `FSDataInputStream` wrapping a `ChecksumFSInputChecker`, which likely led to issues with stream handling and file length management. The patch introduces a new `FSDataBoundedInputStream` class that correctly encapsulates the file system and file path, ensuring proper management of the input stream and its associated file length, thus resolving the failure in the `TestFSInputChecker`.
